author: Pi421337
quote:
The game isn't perfect, because it doesn't pretend to be perfect. It pretends to be a Metroid Prime game, a series that is about 20 years old. And at that, it excels.
There are many AAA games out there to experience, but going back to the gameplay and experience of a Metroid Prime game in 2025 is very refreshing and exciting.
Many of the game's cited flaws are just a consequence of being a Metroid Prime game in the first place. Fans will adore it, but new players may be disappointed by oldish gameplay.

quote: A shame. Purely and simply. Don't buy this game. Don't encourage mediocrity.
